units.source_text: 我坐在椅子上，顾不上去查刑法第一千二百八十五条，

en.t: I sat in the chair and, without even stopping to look up Article 1285 of the penal code,

units.source_text: 却立刻问培卟：“培卟君，恕我直言，

en.t: I immediately asked Pepp, "Pepp, forgive me for speaking plainly,

units.source_text: 这个国家难道不处分罪犯吗？”

en.t: does this country really not punish criminals?"
